svg.desc: Royal Norwegian Embassy LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT The Norwegian Embassy in Egypt COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2009 16 mil EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Renovation and expansion of the administrative building and the apartments inside the existing building. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
